rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The SDP leader election was announced on 26 January.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: As no one other than 又市征治 (secretary-general and election committee chair) filed by the close of filings, his uncontested election was decided.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The page adds that the leader's term is two years and that 又市征治 would formally take office at the party convention in late February that elects the new executive.
